# Arc de Triomphe Paris

> > Official site for the Arc de Triomphe, one of Paris's most iconic monuments, offering visitor information, educational programs, and insights into French history and heritage.

Managed by the Centre des monuments nationaux, the Arc de Triomphe stands at the center of Place Charles de Gaulle, offering panoramic views of Paris from the Champs-Élysées to La Défense. The monument houses significant collections including sculptures, artwork commemorating Napoleon's victories, and the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier.

## Key Topics

- Arc de Triomphe monument
- Champs-Élysées and Place Charles de Gaulle
- Centre des monuments nationaux
- François Rude's La Marseillaise sculpture
- Napoleon I and French Empire history
- Victor Hugo and 19th century France
- Tomb of the Unknown Soldier (Soldat Inconnu)
- Panoramic terrace views of Paris
- Heritage education programs
- Guided conference tours
- Sculpture and iconography collections
- French Republic symbolism
- Accessibility for visitors with disabilities
- Corporate patronage and foundations

## Visiting the Monument

- [El panorama | Arco de Triunfo](https://www.paris-arc-de-triomphe.fr/es/descubra/el-panorama): 360° panoramic terrace view of Paris from Champs-Élysées to La Défense
- [Focus on the collections | Arc de Triomphe](https://www.paris-arc-de-triomphe.fr/en/discover/focus-on-the-collections): Sculptures, plaster casts & artwork collections at Arc de Triomphe
- [The bookshop-boutique | Arc de Triomphe](https://www.paris-arc-de-triomphe.fr/en/visit/the-bookshop-boutique): Gift shop and bookstore for Arc de Triomphe souvenirs and merchandise
- [Instalaciones para visitantes sordos y con discapacidad auditiva | Arco de Triunfo](https://www.paris-arc-de-triomphe.fr/es/visite/visitantes-con-discapacidad/instalaciones-para-visitantes-sordos-y-con-discapacidad-auditiva): Accessibility facilities for deaf & hearing-impaired visitors with LSF
- [Visite en LSF et ludothèque | Arc de triomphe](https://www.paris-arc-de-triomphe.fr/agenda/visite-en-lsf-et-ludotheque): LSF sign language tour with family game library by L'Oiseau Jeu

## History and Heritage

- [Victor Hugo y el Arc de triomphe | Arco de Triunfo](https://www.paris-arc-de-triomphe.fr/es/descubra/victor-hugo-y-el-arc-de-triomphe): Victor Hugo's connection to Arc de Triomphe through 19th century France
- [Primeras funciones políticas y honoríficas | Arco de Triunfo](https://www.paris-arc-de-triomphe.fr/es/descubra/primeras-funciones-politicas-y-honorificas): Early political & ceremonial functions during July Monarchy & Second Empire
- [The Arc de triomphe, a symbol of the Republic | Arc de Triomphe](https://www.paris-arc-de-triomphe.fr/en/teachers/higher-education/the-arc-de-triomphe-a-symbol-of-the-republic): Higher education program on Arc de Triomphe as French Republic symbol
- [Napoleon I. From history to myth | Arc de Triomphe](https://www.paris-arc-de-triomphe.fr/en/teachers/high-school/napoleon-i.-from-history-to-myth): High school workshop on Napoleon I's historical legacy and mythology

## Educational Programs

- [Victor Hugo and the Arc de triomphe | Arc de Triomphe](https://www.paris-arc-de-triomphe.fr/en/teachers/middle-school/victor-hugo-and-the-arc-de-triomphe): Middle school program exploring Victor Hugo & literary heritage workshops
- [Arc de triomphe : arts et symboles | Arc de triomphe](https://www.paris-arc-de-triomphe.fr/enseignants/lycee/arc-de-triomphe-arts-et-symboles): High school program on Arc de Triomphe arts, symbols & iconography
- [Émotions en sculpture. Parcours-découverte | Arc de triomphe](https://www.paris-arc-de-triomphe.fr/enseignants/cycle-2/emotions-en-sculpture.-parcours-decouverte): Cycle 2 discovery tour exploring emotions in Arc de Triomphe sculptures
- [Faune et flore en sculpture. Parcours-découverte | Arc de triomphe](https://www.paris-arc-de-triomphe.fr/enseignants/cycle-2/faune-et-flore-en-sculpture.-parcours-decouverte): Cycle 2 discovery tour on fauna & flora in Arc de Triomphe sculptures

## Guided Tours and Conferences

- [Visite conférence - Parcours découverte | Arc de triomphe](https://www.paris-arc-de-triomphe.fr/agenda/visite-conference-parcours-decouverte): Guided discovery tour covering La Marseillaise & Haussmann's architecture
- [Conference tour | Arc de Triomphe](https://www.paris-arc-de-triomphe.fr/en/adult-groups-and-tourism-professionals/associations-clubs-and-independent-groups/conference-tour): Guided conference tours for associations & independent adult groups
- [Visite conférence | Arc de triomphe](https://www.paris-arc-de-triomphe.fr/groupes-adultes-et-professionnels-du-tourisme/hebergeurs-et-restaurateurs/visite-conference): Conference tours for hospitality professionals with 2026 group rates
- [Visite conférence | Arc de triomphe](https://www.paris-arc-de-triomphe.fr/groupes-adultes-et-professionnels-du-tourisme/professionnels-de-l-evenementiel-et-du-tourisme-d-affaires/visite-conference): Conference tours for event & business tourism professionals with pricing

## Professional Services

- [Events and business tourism professionals | Arc de Triomphe](https://www.paris-arc-de-triomphe.fr/en/adult-groups-and-tourism-professionals/events-and-business-tourism-professionals): Business tourism & event planning services near Champs-Élysées
- [Companies and foundations | Arc de Triomphe](https://www.paris-arc-de-triomphe.fr/en/companies-and-foundations): Corporate partnerships & tax benefits for Arc de Triomphe sponsorship
- [Entreprises et fondations | Arc de triomphe](https://www.paris-arc-de-triomphe.fr/entreprises-et-fondations): Corporate sponsorship & patronage opportunities for heritage preservation
